interpretation: The retained WPR boot registry CSV was large enough to include Session Manager\Kernel key opens and QueryValue rows for adjacent values, but a targeted filter over the full CSV found no rows containing any of the four DpcWatchdogProfile value names. This is target-specific negative runtime evidence: the exact runtime read gap remains open and is not explained by an inability to preserve value names in the CSV format.
limitations: This is a filter over an existing WPR boot CSV, not a new trace.
A no-hit result does not prove the values are never read by another boot path or trigger.
The filter only searches rendered CSV text for exact value-name strings.
